title: Emporia EV Circuit Overnight Load Share
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=emporia:circuit
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=0 AND hour<6
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(if(match(circuit,"(?i)ev"),kwh,0))) as ev_kwh, sum(kwh) as total_kwh by _time
| eval ev_share_pct=round(100*ev_kwh/total_kwh,1)
| where total_kwh>0
| sort - _time
description: Uses Emporia circuit telemetry telemetry to monitor what share of overnight consumption is coming from EV charging in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for homes where vehicle charging dominates night load, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Emporia circuit telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily chart of EV share of overnight kWh.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges what share of overnight consumption is coming from EV charging so you can spot homes where vehicle charging dominates night load before it becomes annoying.
